links.comparator_used: AI-only decision (group 2, LLM guideline-based algorithm acting alone); MTB-only also reported
links.outcome: Change in diagnosis and/or treatment plan after the decision (D+TP) at 1 and 6 months
links.effect: D+TP change at 6 months: MTB+AI 14.73% vs AI only 24.3% vs MTB only 28.08%; at 1 month: 4.86% vs 8.78% vs 13.12%. Treatment plan change at 6 months: 15.5% vs 22.84%. MTB+AI was significantly better than both other groups. Time to recommendation was 29.2 vs 22.4 min for AI only, but 36.9 min for MTB only.
links.tradeoff: MTB+AI took longer than AI alone: preparation time 26.9 vs 19.7 min, decision time 4.9 vs 2.1 min, time to recommendation 29.2 vs 22.4 min. Cases where MTB and AI disagreed had to go back to the MTB for a final decision.
links.quote: The combination of the MTB with AI gives the most effective result in reducing the change in D and TP from 28.08% to 14.73% within 6 months (13.12% vs 4.86% in 1 month).
